heading_fil: Ubos ang supplies bago matapos ang linggo
heading_en: Supplies run out before the week ends
display_fil: Si Elena, 38, ay nakakita ng tumutulong gripo, paulit-ulit na printing at gamit na hindi makita. Itala ang nasasayang na tubig, papel, kuryente at oras bago magmungkahi ng pagbabago.
display_en: Elena, 38, finds a leaking tap, repeated printing and misplaced supplies. Record wasted water, paper, electricity and time before proposing changes.

heading_en: Find it, count it, return it
display_fil: May label na puwesto → bilang at expiry check → report ng expired o damaged → ibalik ang reusable teaching materials. Huwag ipamigay ang expired para maubos lang.
display_en: Labeled location → count and expiry check → report expired or damaged items → return reusable teaching materials. Do not distribute expired stock just to use it up.

check.prompt_fil: May apat na lumang handout at walang kasalukuyang bersyon sa kit. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The kit has four outdated handouts and no current version. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Ipamahagi ang luma para hindi masayang.
options.en: Distribute the old copies so they are not wasted.

options.fil: Palitan ang label at ituring na aprubado ang luma.
options.en: Relabel the old copies as approved.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang luma, tiyakin ang aprubadong master at humingi ng kasalukuyang kopya.
options.en: Set aside the old copies, verify the approved master and request current copies.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikatlong sagot ang nagpoprotekta sa tamang impormasyon. Hindi nagiging tama ang lumang bersyon dahil sayang itong itapon o palitan ang label.
check.feedback_en: The third response protects correct information. An outdated version does not become valid because disposal feels wasteful or its label is changed.

display_fil: 7S: alisin ang di kailangan, ayusin, linisin, standardize, tiyaking ligtas, gawin ang tungkulin, panatilihin. Sa teaching kit: label, checklist, cleaning routine at taong susuri bago at pagkatapos.
display_en: 7S: sort, systematize, sweep, standardize, safety, self-discipline, sustain. For a teaching kit: label, checklist, cleaning routine and a person checking before and after use.

display_fil: Resource → nakitang pag-aaksaya → ebidensya → ligtas na hakbang. Label at bilang bago mag-order.
display_en: Resource → observed waste → evidence → safe step. Label and count before ordering.

display_fil: Magsimula sa nakitang pag-aaksaya at maayos na routine, hindi sa hula na kulang ang budget.
display_en: Start with observed waste and a reliable routine, not an assumption that the budget is insufficient.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi makita ang handouts kaya may gustong mag-order ulit. Ano muna?
check.prompt_en: Handouts cannot be found, so someone wants to reorder. What first?

options.fil: Mag-order agad ng doble para sigurado.
Suriin ang labeled storage, approved version at bilang ng stock.
options.en: Check labeled storage, approved version and stock count.

options.fil: Gamitin ang anumang lumang handout na makita.
options.en: Use any old handout that can be found.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang sagot ay sinusuri ang tunay na pangangailangan at tamang materyal. Ang dobleng order ay maaaring pag-aaksaya; ang lumang handout ay maaaring maling bersyon.
check.feedback_en: The second response checks actual need and the correct material. Duplicate ordering may waste resources; an old handout may be the wrong version.
